paper.title: Procollagen-lysine 2-oxoglutarate 5-dioxygenase 2 promotes collagen cross-linking and ECM stiffening to induce liver fibrosis

frozen_question: Was the qualifying fibrotic/mechanical state directly established in the same Yue 2024 causal root at the day-7 boundary before therapeutic Plod2 siRNA began?

same_paper_evidence.therapeutic_start: Plod2 siRNA injected at day 7 of CCl4 administration before the third CCl4 injection; CCl4 continued for 14 days thereafter.
day7_direct_evidence: Plod2 hepatic mRNA significantly up-regulated from day 7
Plod2 protein increased at the indicated fibrotic-liver time points

direct_mechanical_baseline.result: fibrotic liver ECM approximately 2.06-fold stiffer than control

therapeutic_endpoint.direction: Plod2 siRNA reduced crosslinking/stiffness/fibrosis and liver-injury readouts relative to scramble control.

c1_test.required: The relevant repair/fibrotic physical state must be directly demonstrated as established in the SAME causal model/time window before intervention.
c1_test.reason: The public same-paper root directly establishes Plod2 induction at day 7, but its explicit AFM characterization of the pre-existing fibrotic mechanical state is reported for 28-day CCl4 liver, not for the exact day-7 pre-siRNA boundary. Molecular-pathway induction is not accepted as direct physical-lock establishment.

independent_support_not_fused.paper: Increased stiffness of the rat liver precedes matrix deposition: implications for fibrosis
independent_support_not_fused.finding: In an independent CCl4 rat model, whole-liver shear modulus was already significantly elevated at day 7.
independent_support_not_fused.reason: The strict gate forbids cross-paper and cross-model fusion to manufacture a single-root 5/5 admission.

decision.reason: UNKNOWN in C1 is terminal for this frozen root unless new same-root provenance directly resolves the pre-intervention state.
